about: Starter rulebook for Halal Check. Rulings differ between scholars and certifiers. Have a knowledgeable person review every rule before public use, and add a source for each one.

rules.label: Pork or pork product
rules.reason: Pork and pork products are prohibited.

rules.label: Bacon flavour
rules.reason: Bacon flavour can be made without pork, but some contains it.
rules.question: Ask the maker whether the bacon flavour contains pork, or look for a halal logo.

rules.label: Blood
rules.reason: Blood is prohibited.

rules.label: Blood orange
rules.reason: A fruit, not blood.

rules.label: Alcoholic drink as an ingredient
rules.reason: Alcoholic drinks are prohibited, including when used in cooking.
rules.note: A few scholars allow alcohol that is fully cooked off. Most certifiers do not.

rules.label: Name that does not mean alcohol
rules.reason: These names do not mean alcohol is present.

rules.label: Alcohol flavour or extract
rules.reason: A flavour or extract with an alcohol name may or may not contain alcohol.
rules.question: Ask the maker whether the flavour contains alcohol.

rules.label: Wine or sherry vinegar
rules.reason: Vinegar made from wine. Many scholars accept it once it has turned to vinegar, and some do not.
rules.question: Check your own school's view on wine vinegar.

rules.label: Alcohol (ethanol)
rules.reason: Ethanol is used as a solvent or carrier in some flavours and extracts.
rules.note: Scholars and certifiers differ on small amounts used as a carrier.
rules.question: Ask the maker how much alcohol is used and why, or check your certifier's rule.

rules.label: Not drinking alcohol
rules.reason: These are not drinking alcohol.

rules.label: Gelatin
rules.reason: Gelatin often comes from pork, or from cattle that may not be halal slaughtered.
rules.question: Ask the maker for the gelatin source, or look for a halal logo or fish gelatin.

rules.label: Gelatin with a stated fish or halal source
rules.reason: The label states a fish or halal source.
rules.note: A halal claim written in an ingredient list is the maker's own statement.

rules.label: Collagen
rules.reason: Collagen usually comes from cattle or pigs.
rules.question: Ask for the collagen source, or look for marine collagen or a halal logo.

rules.label: Meat or poultry
rules.reason: Meat must come from an animal slaughtered by halal rules. A label cannot show this.
rules.question: Ask for the halal certificate for the meat, or buy products with a halal logo.

rules.label: Meat the label calls halal
rules.reason: The ingredient list says the meat is halal.
rules.note: This is the maker's own statement. Look for the certifier's logo on the pack.

rules.label: Plant broth
rules.reason: A plant broth.

rules.label: Meat flavour or seasoning
rules.reason: Meat flavour can be made without meat, but some contains it.
rules.question: Ask the maker whether the flavour contains meat, or look for a halal logo.

rules.label: Sausage or cured meat
rules.reason: Often made with pork, or with meat that may not be halal slaughtered.
rules.question: Check the meat type and look for a halal logo.

rules.label: Animal fat
rules.reason: Animal fat can come from pork, or from animals that may not be halal slaughtered.
rules.question: Ask for the animal source, or look for a halal logo.

rules.label: Enzymes (source not stated)
rules.reason: Enzymes can come from animals, including pigs, or from microbes and plants.
rules.question: Ask whether the enzymes are microbial or plant based, or look for a halal logo.

rules.label: Enzymes with a stated non-animal source
rules.reason: The label states a non-animal source.

rules.label: Rennet
rules.reason: Rennet is often taken from calves. Some is made by microbes.
rules.question: Ask whether the rennet is microbial or vegetarian, or look for a halal logo.

rules.label: Cheese or whey
rules.reason: Cheese and whey can involve animal rennet. The source is rarely on the label.
rules.question: Look for microbial or vegetarian rennet, or a halal logo.

rules.label: Flavouring (source not stated)
rules.reason: Flavourings can use alcohol as a carrier or contain animal material. The label rarely says.

rules.label: Vanilla extract
rules.reason: Vanilla extract is usually made with alcohol. Many scholars accept small amounts, others do not.

rules.label: Soy sauce
rules.reason: Brewed soy sauce can contain a small amount of alcohol from fermentation. Views differ.

rules.label: Glycerin
rules.reason: Glycerin can be plant or animal based. The source is rarely on the label.

rules.label: Stearic acid or stearates
rules.reason: Fatty acids can be plant or animal based. The source is rarely on the label.

rules.label: Fatty-acid emulsifier (source not stated)
rules.pattern: \b(?:e(?:430|431|432|433|434|435|436|470a|470b|471|472[a-f]|473|474|475|476|477|478|479b|481|482|483|491|492|493|494|495)|mono[- ]{0,2}(?:and|&)[- ]{0,2}di-?glycerides?(?: of fatty acids)?|monoglycerides?|diglycerides?|polysorbate(?: 60| 65| 80)?|sorbitan (?:mono|tri)stearate|sucrose esters?(?: of fatty acids)?)\b
rules.reason: Made from fatty acids that can be animal or plant based. The source is rarely on the label.
rules.question: Ask the maker whether the emulsifier is plant based, or look for a halal or vegan logo.
examples: mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids

rules.label: Emulsifier with a stated plant source
rules.reason: The label states a plant source.

rules.label: Carmine (insect-based red colour)
rules.reason: A red colour made from insects.
rules.note: Scholars and certifiers differ on insect-derived ingredients.
rules.question: Check your own school's view, or look for a halal logo.

rules.label: Shellac (insect-based glaze)
rules.reason: A glaze made from an insect secretion.
rules.note: Scholars and certifiers differ on insect-derived ingredients.
rules.question: Check your own school's view, or look for a halal logo.

rules.label: L-cysteine
rules.reason: Can come from animal hair or feathers. Some is made without animals.
rules.question: Ask the maker whether the L-cysteine is synthetic or plant based.

rules.label: Bone-derived ingredient
rules.reason: Made from animal bones.
rules.question: Ask for the animal source, or look for a halal logo.

rules.label: Flavour enhancer (source not stated)
rules.reason: Can be made from meat, fish or plant sources.
rules.question: Ask the maker for the source of the flavour enhancer.

rules.label: Shellfish or other seafood
rules.reason: Views on some seafood differ between schools of thought.
rules.question: Follow your own school's view on shellfish.
